_help: Co-op networking config (Netz). Read by scripts/net/net_config.gd (NetConfig.get_value); every key has a constant fallback there, so a missing key or a missing file keeps the defaults. Solo play never reads the co-op sections (downed, points, drops, scaling). Values marked "economy" mean: use the solo value from data/economy.json via Progress.

downed._help: Black Ops style: a player at 0 HP goes down, a teammate holds interact for revive_time_s within revive_range_m; bleed_out_s later they die (spectate until the next round). Game over when everyone is down or dead. Solo keeps the old death = game over.

points._help: Host-authoritative per-player points (Black Ops style). Each accepted hit / kill / revive is credited host-side to the peer who did it; the host replicates every player's total. Spending is a request to the host.

scaling._help: Zombies per round x (1 + per_extra_player x (players - 1)); max_alive grows the same way, capped at max_alive_cap. Zombie HP unchanged.

spend._help: M13: co-op door buys and paid Field Card rerolls are charged by the host. timeout_s = how long a client waits for the host's answer before the reroll counts as refused (a late yes is refunded); door_retry_s = min gap between door requests per door.

avatar._help: Remote players' third-person body (scripts/net/avatar). body = "desi" (assets/models/player/player.glb via NetDesiBody) or "capsule" (placeholder). Walk/run playback is scaled by speed / clip foot speed (Desi: Walk 1.16, CrouchWalk 0.77, Run ~6.2, Sprint ~9.5 m/s).
